title: Accepting Bitcoin for Ebook Sales: A Step-by-Step Deployment Guide
author: COREMERCH
excerpt: Selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, and digital downloads with automated crypto delivery — no platform middleman, no payout delays, no geographic filter.

content.text: In countries like Zimbabwe, where PayPal and Stripe are restricted, digital creators face significant challenges in selling ebooks and other digital products online. This infrastructure gap can be bridged with a sovereign commerce stack, enabling creators to accept bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies for their digital goods, thereby bypassing traditional payment platforms. This guide will walk you through deploying such a stack.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The key to this infrastructure's success lies in its use of decentralized technologies, such as blockchain for payment verification and cloud services for hosting and delivery. By leveraging GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, and NOWPayments for crypto transactions, creators can ensure their digital stores remain operational without dependence on restrictive platforms. This approach also ensures that the creator retains full ownership of their data and customer relationships.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your sovereign commerce stack, you'll need to decide on the specific components that best fit your needs. This includes choosing a hosting platform, a backend logic service like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and a storage solution such as Supabase or Google Sheets for managing orders. Understanding your product offerings and target audience is also crucial for configuring your store effectively.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

The product types that work with automated crypto delivery are any digital files that can be stored and delivered via download link: ebooks in PDF or EPUB format, courses packaged as ZIP archives or delivered via hosted video links, Notion templates exported as files or share links, font families as ZIP archives of OTF and TTF files, Lightroom or Capture One preset packs, beat files as WAV or MP3 archives, plugin installers, stock photo packs, software license keys, and any other file-based product. The delivery system in Stack 01 uses Google Drive shared links. Stack 02 uses Cloudflare R2 presigned URLs with configurable expiry times — typically 24 to 72 hours — which prevents download links from being shared indefinitely after a single purchase.
Decentralized technologies empower digital creators to bypass restrictive platforms.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your stack is configured, going live is a matter of making your store accessible to the public. Processing your first transaction is a milestone, as it validates the functionality of your setup. Monitoring the first few transactions closely can help identify any potential issues and ensure a smooth experience for your customers. With the right infrastructure in place, you can focus on marketing and growing your customer base.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Scaling a sovereign digital store requires no infrastructure changes at any realistic volume level for most individual creators. Cloudflare Workers processes each webhook event independently — ten simultaneous orders are handled as ten separate processes with no queue congestion. Supabase handles hundreds of concurrent database operations on the free tier. Resend delivers 3,000 emails per month on the free tier — enough for significant daily sales volume. Cloudflare Pages serves the storefront to any number of concurrent visitors without capacity constraints. NOWPayments processes payment volume without per-transaction approval delays. The Sovereign Blueprint documents exactly when and how to upgrade each layer of the stack as volume increases — which thresholds trigger which upgrades, and how to migrate without any downtime.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, you can utilize a sovereign commerce stack that integrates crypto payments, such as bitcoin, and automated delivery. This approach bypasses traditional platforms, giving you full control over your sales process and customer data. With the right stack, you can efficiently manage orders, deliver products instantly, and scale your business as it grows.
Automated delivery ensures instant access to digital products upon payment.
